title: poe/1.0/problem-report
description: A problem report (DIDComm Messaging spec, Problem Reports), adopted into this protocol. pthid is the thid of the thread where the problem occurred. Codes include invalid_proof; body.explain and details may accompany code.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. REQUIRED when the message is authcrypted.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.

ack.description: Ids of the message(s) that triggered the problem.

code.description: Problem code: sorter (e = error, w = warning), scope (p = protocol, m = message, or a state name), then descriptors, dot-separated, lower kebab-case. E.g. e.p.xfer.cant-use-endpoint.

comment.description: Human-friendly text statically associated with code; {1}, {2}, ... interpolate args.
